name: Better Experience for Reroute emails module
description: Adds a friendlier settings UI, granular permissions, governance roles and a status block on top of the Reroute Email module.
project_description:
This module lives aside Reroute Email module, improving user Experience with enhanced features tailored for data governance.

 Features 
 
 Introduces roles and concepts for Data Governance:
 
 Roles (Data Owner, Data Steward, Data Custodian).
 Permissions per field. With more granular permissions, you can split actions on settings form across more Roles. IE: only Data Owner can edit destination and skipped addresses.
 
 Add a visual themeable check of the rerouting status. With this, testers are protected from unwanted mail to users/subscribers.
 Add custom drush commands to automate the rerouting status switch with granular actions (email notifications to email address with responsibilities on data).
